subject: Scheduling: Exec demo for BluePeak - preferred times and recording option
messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@bluepeakmedia.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: scheduling@bluepeakmedia.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0400
Subject: Exec demo availability for BluePeak (week of Oct 19)

Hi Laura,

Hope you're well. We're trying to lock in an executive-level demo for BluePeak with our CMO and Head of Product. Their windows are tight — they have a recurring exec block 8:00–9:00am PT (11:00–12:00pm ET) on Tuesdays and Thursdays.

Would Redwood be able to do a 30–40 minute executive walkthrough during that slot on Tuesday, Oct 21? If that's rough for the EU engineering team, we can consider recording a short technical appendix for our engineering leads in APAC. We're sensitive to daylight savings changes coming up in late October and want to avoid any calendar confusion if we need to move dates.

Also: we prefer a very short Q&A at the end (15–20 minutes). If you need any materials ahead of time, let me know.

Thanks,
Ethan
Ethan Cole
Director of Product 
BluePeak Media
(415) 555-0123

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@bluepeakmedia.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, mina_haddad@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 16:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Exec demo availability for BluePeak (week of Oct 19)

Ethan — thanks for the clarity and heads up on the exec block. Tuesday 11:00am ET (8:00am PT) is likely workable on our side for a focused exec walkthrough + 15–20 min Q&A. A few scheduling notes so we don't run into the DST trap you mentioned: EU clocks are still on CEST until Oct 25 this year, so Oct 21 will convert to 5:00pm CEST for our EU engineers. If we were scheduling after Oct 25 the same wall-clock times would shift by one hour for EU participants, which is worth watching if we need to move the meeting.

Quick options:
- Option A: Live exec walkthrough Tue Oct 21 at 11:00am ET / 17:00 CEST (30–40m). EU engineers join live for the Q&A.
- Option B: Exec-only live session at 11:00am ET with a separated technical deep-dive recorded or scheduled as a follow-up at an APAC-friendly hour (we can provide a recording + live office hours for APAC).

Marissa (SE) and Mina (platform) are looped for technical availability. If you confirm Option A, we'll send an invite and attach a short agenda. If you prefer Option B, we'll share a time for the tech session and a recording plan.

I attached a one-pager agenda and will draft the calendar invite once you confirm.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com

So please schedule:
- Tuesday Oct 21, 2026 — Exec walkthrough — 8:00am PT / 11:00am ET / 17:00 CEST (30	60 min + 15	60 Q&A)

Also: make sure the calendar invite correctly reflects times across time zones — we had an earlier snafu last year when EU moved clocks back and invites showed the wrong hour.

Confirm when you send the invite and the recording plan.

Appreciate it,
Ethan
